inputs.locator: Accepted design disposition is TWO_STAGE_EXPLICIT_OUTPUT_CLASSIFICATION_CONTRACT_READY at accepted result commit e6750b29540d1e4672766f7f4c77ffafc9b66459. Implement only its exact companion-only four-file slice; do not widen or reinterpret the design.

Create exactly research_pipeline/local-weekly-output-classification.v1.schema.json, research_pipeline/local_weekly_output_classification.py, research_pipeline/tests/test_local_weekly_output_classification.py, and docs/local-weekly-output-classification-v1.md. This bootstrap implementation cannot count itself because no executable companion contract existed before dispatch. Do not create retrospective intent or acceptance examples. Classification authority begins only after Manager accepts and commits this implementation.

objective: Implement the accepted prospective Local Research weekly-output classification contract as exactly four new offline files: one closed Draft 2020-12 companion schema, one pure read-only validator/supplement module, one deterministic synthetic test module, and one bounded document. Preserve existing task/dispatch/result schemas and all historical closures. Prove PRE_DISPATCH_INTENT existed as exact Git-object bytes at result.source_git_commit, prove the accepted result bytes and commit ancestry, validate exact closure and claim-boundary binding, enforce frozen COUNT/EXCLUDE and duplicate-family semantics, and return deterministic raw-output plus unique-family counts from an explicit acceptance allowlist and half-open UTC period. Add no CLI, scan, report integration, timer, writer, state access, strategy, candidate, OOS, server or Trading action.
stop_conditions: Before editing, validate exact task and dispatch bytes; re-hash every non-null input and require clean post-commit HEAD equal local origin from Manager receipt. Reject links, duplicate locators, source drift or any pre-existing target.
Create exactly the four named absent files. Do not modify an existing path or create generated, ignored, cache, temporary or state output inside the repository.

The schema must be Draft 2020-12, recursively closed, and express exactly PRE_DISPATCH_INTENT and MANAGER_ACCEPTANCE alternatives with the field names and constants frozen by the accepted design result.
Freeze output classes MECHANISM_CONCLUSION, SPEC_OR_CAPABILITY_SLICE and NON_COUNTING; actions COUNT and EXCLUDE; independence UNIQUE_FAMILY, NESTED_NON_INDEPENDENT and NON_COUNTING_NOT_APPLICABLE.

PRE_DISPATCH_INTENT must bind output and intent ids/path, exact task/dispatch identities and hashes, output class, unique disposition/action mappings, canonical JSON-scalar claim digest, family key, independence, issuance, Manager, research-only scope and zero variants.

MANAGER_ACCEPTANCE must bind intent bytes, exact task/dispatch/result identities and hashes, result status/time/source commit, accepted disposition, accepted-result commit, all-false safety, outcome, exclusion reason, acceptance time, Manager and research-only scope.
Reuse existing task/dispatch/result semantic validators for the transitive closure. Do not duplicate or weaken their authority, policy, stop-hash, OOS, safety or performance-case rules.

For every allowlisted row, require a clean current HEAD, exact HEAD acceptance bytes, exact source_git_commit:intent_path bytes, and exact accepted_result_commit:result_path bytes. Require accepted-result commit ancestry; timestamps cannot substitute.

Compute claim_boundary_sha256 from the no-newline canonical UTF-8 JSON scalar bytes of exact dispatch.performance_case.claim_boundary. Reject any path, hash, id, claim, disposition, result field or safety drift.

COMPLETED is necessary but insufficient for COUNT. BLOCKED and FAILED always EXCLUDE. NON_COUNTING may only EXCLUDE. EXCLUDE requires a nonempty reason; COUNT requires null. The outcome must equal the pre-frozen disposition action.

Reject duplicate output_id, duplicate acceptance for one intent, one result bound to multiple intents, repeated disposition labels and ambiguous family semantics. Shared counted families require every member NESTED_NON_INDEPENDENT.

Accept only an explicit nonempty allowlist of acceptance paths and one valid half-open timezone-aware UTC period. Read only those records, transitively named paths and exact Git objects; do not scan a directory, Git log, thread, server, report or state.

Return deterministic canonical JSON data in memory with lexicographically sorted row identities and exclusions, raw COUNT totals by class and distinct duplicate_family_key totals by class. Never write output or mutate the supplied repository.

Tests must use isolated temporary Git repositories outside the workspace and prove a positive two-stage lifecycle plus missing/post-outcome intent, non-ancestor result, drift, period, status, safety, disposition, exclusion, duplicate and family failures.

Tests must validate both schema alternatives and unknown-field rejection, exact Git-object behavior, deterministic repeated output, no repository write, and separate raw mechanism count two versus shared family count one.

Run only focused Python compile/import, Draft 2020-12 schema check, the new unit-test module and git diff checks. Do not execute network, server, adapter, Java, Maven, Spring, systemd, canonical or Trading commands.

Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero. The implementation may claim deterministic research-output visibility only; prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, R2 outcome, OOS and activation remain MISSING_PROOF.

Status COMPLETED requires exactly four files_changed and four artifact hashes, source_git_dirty_after=true, all safety assertions false, focused PASS evidence, the frozen positive disposition and an explicit MISSING_PROOF register. Do not stage, commit or push.

Stop on any input drift, unrelated dirt, need for a fifth implementation file, existing schema/report/CLI change, ambiguous authority rule, test failure outside the four files, network need or any canonical/server/trading access.

Do not create classification intent or acceptance records for this bootstrap task. A positive result only makes the contract available prospectively after Manager independently validates and commits it.
